1. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The dependent is a requirement sentence (structured) elaborated over four recorded prose commitments (natural): drift as the open record whose workspace is gone, with reconcile reporting and repairing nothing (vuopwuyo); the registry-local record and the workspace it names by reference (owyntkvw); the open/landed lifecycle that fixes which absences count (vkkwusty); and jj as the backend that owns whether a workspace exists (xkolyytz). The natural→structured gate cell therefore applies edge by edge: the requirement may narrow what each prerequisite states and may not contradict it, so the check is non-violation against every parent and never a behavior probe; the element at issue is discovered at check time, not named here. No artifact path is licensed for this unit, and the child is words rather than a runnable artifact, so the criterion lives inline.
